_note: The tester's lines (af_heart): drives VoiceOver, says what she hears.

lines.t-hello: Hi, I'm the tester. I'll use VoiceOver, the screen reader built into the Mac, and tell you what I hear.
lines.t-open: Here's a page of the latest stories, in Safari, with VoiceOver on. There are three stories, and each one ends in a link that says Read more. Screen reader users often jump from link to link to see where they can go, so that's what I'll do.
lines.t-missing: Three links, and VoiceOver said the same thing each time: Read more, link. Nothing tells me which story each one opens.
lines.t-again: The same three jumps, on the fixed page.
lines.t-heard: Now each link names its story: a new bridge, library hours, and the farmers market.
